name: WCT
recent: WCT Holdings 在 2026 年 11 月进行高层人事调整，委任 Lai Cheng Yee 为集团董事经理，Lee Tuck Fook 改任执行副主席。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3.7032 亿令吉，净利 1627 万令吉。
notable: 委任 Lai Cheng Yee 为集团董事经理。
Lee Tuck Fook 改任执行副主席。
公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩。
risks: 执行主席 Tan Sri Lim Siew Choon 通知在闭市期内有交易公司证券的意向。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3.7032 亿令吉，环比下降 16.8%，同比下降 33.0%；净利为 1627 万令吉，环比下降 13.5%，同比下降 3.7%；净利率为 4.4%。

recent_en: WCT Holdings underwent senior management changes in November 2026, appointing Lai Cheng Yee as Group Managing Director and redesignating Lee Tuck Fook as Executive Vice Chairman. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM370.32 million and net profit was RM16.27 million.
notable_en: Appointed Lai Cheng Yee as Group Managing Director.
Lee Tuck Fook redesignated as Executive Vice Chairman.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Tan Sri Lim Siew Choon notified intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM370.32 million, down 16.8% QoQ and 33.0% YoY; net profit was RM16.27 million, down 13.5% QoQ and 3.7% YoY; net margin was 4.4%.
